outcomes.intended_user_result: Recall explains what it considered, matched, included, omitted, and cost locally without changing accepted ranking or scope rules.
outcomes.current_baseline: Lexical scoped recall returns hits and a small coverage object, but does not expose retrieval accounting or elapsed cost.
outcomes.acceptance: Every bounded recall response includes a trace identity, considered/matched/included counts, omission reasons, elapsed duration, and no unauthorized record identifiers.

excluded_scope: No ranking-policy promotion without independent development/holdout evidence.
No model, vector index, graph database, MCP adapter, or new memory backend.
No schema migration or live-data rewrite unless implementation proves it necessary.
